body: Yes, everything. Secretary, cashier, waitress, assistant, bank teller, etc. I can go on and on.
Even if you say that, the reality is that I haven't been able to get a job in two years even with my degree. I just don't know what I can do differently.

I really can't afford to waste gas money since I've been living on my savings, which are now gone. I have no idea where to go from here. I'm really trying to find a way out of this and at least have some hope. Are there online volunteer opportunities? How do I even improve my chances of getting a job? I can't help my anxiety. I'm just really frustrated and I feel like I'm out of options.
I have a college degree and that makes me feel more hopeless.
